name: Editorial home / For you
content: Lead story, latest list, topic navigation, edition time, source-count labels.
action: Open article; change desk; authenticated For you.
states: Loading, partial-feed failure, stale edition, no follows.

name: Topic hub and story trail
content: Desk scope, follow control, ongoing-story grouping, filtered articles.
action: Open article or follow topic.
states: Empty topic, not found, follow failure, renamed slug.

name: Search results
content: Query, topic/date/source-type filters, result count and snippets.
action: Search, refine, clear, open result.
states: Typing, loading, zero results, invalid date range, unavailable search.

name: Canonical article
content: Headline, deck, review/cutoff/version labels, variants, cited narrative, full bottom sources, history, related stories.
action: Read; inspect source; save; share; report.
states: New-version notice, video unavailable, rights withdrawal, partial enhancements failure.

name: Evidence view
content: Claim, sources, evidence-role labels, disagreement, permitted excerpt, source link and back-reference.
action: Open original or return to exact claim.
states: Excerpt not licensed, missing author/date, unavailable original, disputed claim.

name: History and historical article
content: Chronological material changes, version details, correction notes.
action: Read current or safe previous version.
states: Historical warning, redacted version, restored story, unavailable text.

name: Source directory
content: Approved sources, topic/type filters and methodology link.
action: Inspect a source profile.
states: Empty filter, source suspended, metadata unavailable.

name: Source profile
content: Verified identity, review date, topic scope, ownership/limitations, recent public coverage.
action: Open original homepage or related synthesis.
states: Suspended profile; missing ownership information explicitly disclosed.

name: Sign-in and verification
content: Google and email choices, privacy links, return-action context.
action: Authenticate or request/resend link.
states: Pending email, invalid/expired link, provider failure, throttled request.

name: Optional onboarding
content: Topic choices, theme preference, skip control.
action: Follow topics and finish, or skip.
states: No selection, save failure, already-completed onboarding.

name: Saved reading
content: Private saved list, sort and correction/retraction labels.
action: Open or remove bookmark.
states: Empty list, optimistic removal rollback, withdrawn saved item.

name: Account and reading settings
content: Reading preferences, follows, linked identities, sessions, privacy actions.
action: Save preferences, revoke session, begin export/deletion.
states: Unsaved changes, conflict, storage unavailable, reauthentication required.

name: Digest and alert settings
content: Opt-in channels, cadence, timezone, quiet hours, preview, unsubscribe.
action: Confirm subscription or stop messages.
states: Unverified email, invalid timezone, delivery suppression.

name: Report an issue
content: Issue type, article/version/claim context, description, optional evidence URL/contact.
action: Submit report.
states: Invalid input, duplicate, throttled, receipt, offline failure.

name: Methodology and editorial policy
content: Sourcing, independence, AI role, review policy, corrections and rights contact.
action: Open source directory or report an issue.
states: Readable without scripting; anchor navigation.

name: Newsroom queue
content: Assignments, candidate status, risk, blockers, ready-to-review and scheduled work.
action: Open a candidate or resume assignment.
states: Empty queue, stale assignment, insufficient evidence, service outage.

name: Source management
content: Sources, endpoint state, approval/rights expiry and health.
action: Add source or open governance record.
states: Pending review, expired rights, suspended identity, missing credentials.

name: Source governance / intake
content: Identity, scope, review log, grants, endpoint settings, permissioned input test.
action: Approve scope, add grant, run safe intake test, suspend.
states: Denied processing, test failure, conflict, required review, secret reference invalid.

name: Cluster and origin review
content: Event timeline, item versions, duplicates, origins and candidate links.
action: Split/merge, adjust origins, build evidence pack.
states: Possible duplicate event, unknown origin, conflicting dates, stale pack.

name: Evidence and article workbench
content: Sources/claims pane, draft variants, checks, risk, diff, approvals and preview.
action: Edit, validate, submit, approve or publish according to role.
states: Unsaved changes, validation failure, stale approval, lock conflict, lost connection.

name: Reports, corrections and withdrawal
content: Triage queue, affected versions/claims, public change note, purge/deletion state.
action: Investigate, correct, withdraw or close report.
states: Urgent issue, pending remediation, failed purge, duplicate report, disputed claim.

name: Operations and jobs
content: Adapter status, queue age, jobs, dead letters, quotas, kill switches.
action: Pause, inspect failure or replay safely.
states: Provider outage, quota limit, poison item, deletion overdue.

name: Product and quality analytics
content: Quality, engagement, source coverage, cost, review time and denominators.
action: Filter interval or inspect a metric definition.
states: Low sample, no data, delayed pipeline, incomplete interval.

name: Staff access and policy controls
content: Role assignments, session revocation, policy versions, audited feature flags.
action: Change role or disable feature after reauthentication.
states: Forbidden action, missing MFA, stale record, audit failure.

name: Privacy request status
content: Export/deletion state, expiry, consequences and secure action.
action: Retrieve own export or confirm deletion.
states: Pending, ready, expired, failed, canceled before execution.

name: System states
content: 403, 404, withdrawn/410, offline, retryable error and maintenance.
action: Retry, navigate safely or read explanation.
states: No disclosure of private resource existence; avoid retry loops.

name: Suggest a source
content: URL, reason and optional related article.
action: Send suggestion to quarantine.
states: Duplicate, unsupported URL, submission receipt.

name: Collaborative collections
content: Private collections, invited collaborators and access settings.
action: Create or open collection.
states: Invite revoked, expired invite, access denied.

name: Paid products
content: Future entitlement offer and transparent pricing, only after separate approval.
action: No launch action.
states: Not included in launch navigation or prototype critical paths.
